instructions: These are mobile app reviews. Mark every label that the review clearly talks about.

labels.name: Usability
labels.definition: Ease of use, learnability, navigation, interface layout, readability or confusing design.

labels.name: Performance
labels.definition: Speed, loading time, crashes, freezes, bugs, battery drain or accuracy problems (e.g. GPS).

labels.name: Feature Request
labels.definition: The user asks for a new feature or an improvement to an existing one.

labels.name: Privacy & Security
labels.definition: Personal data, privacy, data sharing, account security or login/password problems.

labels.name: Pricing & Ads
labels.definition: Cost, subscriptions, paywalls, billing, refunds or advertisements.

labels.name: Customer Support
labels.definition: Contact with, or responses from, the developer's support team.
